answer:
The simulation is a 2D lid-driven cavity flow of an incompressible fluid.
The cavity is square with width and height of 0.1 m.
The top wall moves to the right with a lid velocity of 1 m/s.
The kinematic viscosity is 0.001 m^2/s, giving a Reynolds number of 100.
Use OpenFOAM with the icoFoam solver.
Use blockMesh with a 20 by 20 uniform mesh in the x-y plane and 1 cell in the z-direction.
Extrude the mesh by 0.01 m in the z-direction.
Set the front and back boundaries to empty boundary conditions.
Set the moving top wall to fixedValue uniform (1 0 0) for U.
Set the bottom, left, and right walls to fixedValue uniform (0 0 0) for U.
Set the pressure p to zeroGradient on all cavity walls.
Set the initial velocity to 0 m/s everywhere.
Set the initial pressure to 0 everywhere.
Use startTime 0, endTime 0.5 s, deltaT 0.002 s, writeControl timeStep, and writeInterval 20.
Run the case with icoFoam.
